subject: Proposal: Premium SLA + Dedicated Capacity at Renewal
messages:
From: Morgan Lane <morgan.lane@agreentech.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@agreentech.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal — exploring Premium SLA + dedicated capacity

Evelyn,

Our renewal is up next quarter and the platform is central to several new product lanes. Were interested in moving to a Premium SLA and reserving a dedicated pool (GPU-backed) to smooth latency spikes. Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood commit to a p99 latency target for text-generation under a committed throughput? We generally need p99 < 250ms for interactive flows.
- What does the uplift look like on pricing and what credits, if any, are available for the first month of migration?

Expected peak: ~350 QPS for short bursts (1–2 minute windows) and steady 110 QPS otherwise.

Looping in Priya (procurement) for timing and PO process. Happy to get a mutual action plan to align teams.

Thanks,
Morgan Lane
Head of Platform
Agreentech

----
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Lane <morgan.lane@agreentech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal — exploring Premium SLA + dedicated capacity

Morgan — great to hear and thanks for the clear targets. High level we can support a p99 latency band and a dedicated capacity pool; exact numbers depend on the model family, quantization, and sequence lengths. Next steps I suggest:

1) Quick capacity sizing call (30 min) to validate workload profile (sequence length distribution + hard peaks).
2) Draft MAP (attached) outlining milestones: sizing call, staging run, canary traffic, cutover, billing date.
3) Proposed offer: Premium SLA add-on + dedicated pool with a three-month onboarding credit; details and pricing in attached SLA draft.

Two quick clarifying Qs: do you need the p99 target to apply across all regions or just US traffic? Also, is the 350 QPS peak a sustained load for periodic batches or single-request bursts?

Attaching: MAP draft (MAP_Agreentech_Q3.xlsx) and a working SLA doc (Redwood_Premium_SLA_v3.pdf).

If that works I can get Ben looped in on pricing and Karthik on configuration/ops. Available for a call today at 2pm PT.

— Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 12:35:04 -0700
Subject: Internal: Agreentech renewal — pricing & concession ask (internal)

Ben / Karthik,

Summary of asks from Agreentech: p99 < 250ms (US), dedicated GPU pool to cover 350 QPS bursts, one month onboarding credit, signed in ~30 days. Attached is their recent latency histogram (latency-stats-agg-202705.csv).

Im recommending the following structure for a tight renewal that also protects Redwood unit economics:
- Standard list pricing for Premium SLA + dedicated pool — then apply a term-based concession: 10% off list in year one if they commit to a 12-month reserved capacity purchase.
- One-time onboarding credit equal to 1% of the first year committed spend (applied to the first invoice) to cover migration validation and staging runs.
- Include a rollback/canary clause: we will provide an agreed canary window for 2 weeks; if latency regressions exceed the agreed tolerance, auto-fallback to shared pool is permitted until remediation.

If Agreentech pushes for a larger credit we should escalate. Also, Karthik: confirm if the dedicated pool sizing youd estimate for their profile would require a 2x buffer for burst smoothing or if software-level prefix/KV caching will reduce the GPU footprint.

Id like to propose we offer the commitment discount and the 1% onboarding credit and see if Procurement accepts. If they ask for a higher credit, well hold firm and offer an additional month of premium support instead.

— Evelyn

Attachments referenced: latency-stats-agg-202705.csv

----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:00:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Agreentech renewal — pricing & concession ask (internal)

Evelyn — I agree with the structure. A few edits to the proposal to tighten operational risk:
- Make the p99 target a sliding band with a clear SLO measurement window (30-day rolling) and explicit per-incident remediation steps.
- Add a one-time onboarding engineering hour bank (40 hours) to be used within the first 90 days; thats usually more meaningful than a pure dollar credit for customers onboarding complex flows.
- For dedicated sizing: Karthik, run the preliminary sizing with 1.5x for bursts and include a caching profile. If we can show the cache will knock per-token compute by ~20% we can avoid a full 2x allocation.

If procurement signs quickly Id be comfortable approving up to the 10% concession and the 1% credit. Anything beyond, we escalate.

— Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Lane <morgan.lane@agreentech.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@agreentech.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final offer: Premium SLA + Dedicated Pool — Agreentech renewal

Morgan / Priya — thanks for the helpful details and for answering the sizing questions. Attached are: Redwood_Premium_SLA_v3.pdf and the MAP (MAP_Agreentech_Q3.xlsx) that reflect the agreed milestones. Summary of the final offer below: 

Offer highlights
- Premium SLA add-on with p99 objective: 250ms (US traffic), measured on a 30-day rolling window. Rebaselining allowed at quarter boundaries with 14-day notice.
- Dedicated GPU pool sized to handle ~350 QPS burst profile (prelim sizing attached). Karthik will run staging with a canary cutover and will provide a final sizing soon.
- Pricing: list price for Premium SLA + dedicated pool, 10% term discount applied for a 12-month reserved capacity commitment.
- Onboarding support: 1% of first-year committed spend as a one-time credit + 40 hours of dedicated engineering onboarding within the first 90 days.
- Canary & rollback: 2-week canary window then staged traffic ramp; auto-fallback policy included in the SLA.

Next steps
1) Priya: confirm procurement timeline and PO cadence. We can prepare a DocuSign package (link below) for signature once you confirm the billing contact and PO reference.
2) Schedule a 30-min sizing call with Karthik and your infra team (Karthik@redwood.ai).
3) Once signed, well schedule the 2-week canary and provide an onboarding runbook.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=RDW-AGT-2027-0421
Atts: Redwood_Premium_SLA_v3.pdf, MAP_Agreentech_Q3.xlsx

If that aligns Ill have legal generate the final contract addendum. Looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
